bio: Set in the beautiful Cotswolds, Minster Mill is the perfect place to enjoy a quaint Afternoon Tea. The chefs fuse contemporary and traditional British cooking and adds a local twist, carefully selecting the best regional and seasonal ingredients.  Set in a high gallery overlooking the restaurant, Mill Bar serves selected fine wines and Champagnes from the Brownsword cellar. Afternoon Tea is served in the Minster Mill restaurant and bar, a sleek space that effortlessly combines rustic charm with clean modern touches. Indulge in the great British tradition underneath original oak beams and an impressive vaulted ceiling, or take your Tea on the picturesque outdoor terrace in warmer weather.  There's something special about seeing your Afternoon Tea arrive to the table on a traditional three-tiered stand, where a vast array of dainty little finger sandwiches, scones with thick clotted cream and preserves and fancies await. Served with your choice of fine Newby teas or coffee, or with a glass of champagne if you're feeling luxurious, this is a leisurely affair to remember.  Perched on the banks of the River Windrush, Minster Mill is ideally situated for those exploring the stunning surroundings of Witney and the Cotswolds.
